source.expected_revision: fresh advertised refs/heads/master; HEAD must equal it and be content-clean

settings_policy.observability: absence and minimal enabled:false both mean disabled; never enable or replace nondefault options

tooling.distribution: external existing pinned direct wrangler-dist/cli.js, no installation or npx

build.revision_stamp: exact deterministic full-SHA worker/src/rev.js, consistent with deploy/stamp-worker-rev.sh
build.artifact_proof: Exact raw compiled SHA256 by default; only a recognized named text multipart part whose raw hash differs may normalize physical CRLF to LF. Blob/file parts stay byte-exact; lone CR, trimming, sourcemap removal and substantive changes are rejected. Receipts separately report wire SHA and any text transport normalization.

verification.public_response_policy: record only ok/agent/rev; never last_run or raw response bodies
verification.provider: one active100% version, git:<fullSHA> annotation, exact module SHA256, stable settings/binding/cron digest before and after

associated_pages.revision_policy: require exact full fresh master SHA and exact served application bytes after automatic Git Pages build

constraints: Worker-only infrastructure publication; no Pages upload, D1 execute/migrate/seed, AI requests, research runs, cron trigger, secrets update, recurring service or executor relocation.
Preserve exact existing D1, AI catalog, ADMIN_TOKEN secret name, compatibility, cron, logpush, tails and disabled observability.
Read named external root-provided token only in publish/verify; build-only is credential-free. Never log credential values, environment options, private body or last_run.
All native commands and descendants are windowless, shell:false, and on MAIN.
Do not stage, reset, change common Git configuration, or alter file permissions; ignore only Windows mode noise with per-command core.filemode=false.
